title: Tanzanian Prawn Curry
community: Swahili coast — the luxury seafood curry
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Tanzanian Mchuzi wa Kamba — large Indian Ocean prawns simmered in a fragrant Zanzibar spice and coconut milk curry. One of the most celebrated seafood dishes on the coast — extraordinary when made with the morning's fresh catch.
longDesc: Prawn curry is the Swahili coast's luxury everyday seafood dish — the Zanzibar spice combination and gentle coconut milk simmer produce a curry of extraordinary fragrance and richness.
steps: Cook onions until golden. Add garlic, ginger, chillies, spices.
Add tomatoes. Cook 6 minutes until thick.
Add coconut milk. Bring to gentle simmer.
Add prawns. Cook gently 4—5 minutes until pink.
chefTips: Loose C = perfect; tight O = overcooked.
cookingScience: See KEN256 for prawn cooking science.
sustainabilityTips: Indian Ocean prawns from local coastal fishermen.
culturalNote: Prawn curry is what the Tanzanian coast does best — the Indian Ocean, the Zanzibar spice tradition, and coastal coconut combined into one magnificent dish.
